mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ticket_orders o INNER JOIN tickets t ON t.id = o.ticket_id INNER JOIN metro_lines l ON l.id = t.line_id INNER JOIN stations start_station ON start_station.id = t.start_station_id INNER JOIN stations end_station ON end_station.id = t.end_station_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
